description: Agent Readiness: submit an agent system’s kill-switch design (what fires it, what it stops, what happens to in-flight actions and to queued and scheduled work, who can restart and the restart paths), its components with what each can do, and any test runs with what they observed. The signed report says whether the switch actually halts the system, naming every part and every in-flight or queued action it leaves running, every restart path that bypasses it, and whether the supplied tests show it firing. Incident plans are wever_incident-plan-check. Verdict label_not_control, halt_unproven or halts. POST /api/kill-switch-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.

can_act.description: It can take actions on its own.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

in_flight.description: What happens to actions already running.

honors_switch.description: The path checks the switch before resuming.

observed.description: What stopped and what kept running.
